newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb Inc Q4 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb Inc Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1995 full year sales include $18,258,000 from divested Sports Optics Division.
1996 sales include $4,722,000 in fourth quarter and $49,631,000 in year revenues from divested Oral Care and Steri-Oss businesses.
1995 sales include $22,510,000 in fourth quarter and $78,136,000 in year revenues from divested Oral Care and Steri-Oss businesses.
CEO retirement in 1995 reduced full year and fourth quarter net earnings by $4,364,000 or $.08 per share.
Restructuring charges reduced full year 1996 net earnings by $10,898,000 or $0.19 per share, and reduced 1995 full year and fourth quarter net earnings by $17,353,000 or $0.30 per share.
Gain on sale of Steri-Oss increased 1996 full year and fourth quarter net earnings by $8,456,000 or $0.15 per share.
Loss on sale of Oral Care Division decreased full year 1996 net earnings by $6,254,000 or $0.11 per share.
Gain on sale of Sports Optics Division increased full year 1995 net earnings by $20,823,000 or $0.36 per share.

Litigation provisions reduced full year 1996 net earnings by $9,982,000 or $0.18 per share, 1995 fourth quarter net earnings by $3,591,000 or $0.06 per share, and full year 1995 net earnings by $14,151,000 or $.24 per share.
